entries.name: Samaritans
entries.desc_en: Free, confidential listening for anyone struggling to cope or having suicidal thoughts, day or night.

entries.name: Macmillan Support Line
entries.desc_en: Cancer support specialists for emotional, practical, financial and medical questions, for patients and families.

entries.name: Maggie's

entries.name: The Brain Tumour Charity
entries.desc_en: Support and Information Line by phone, email or live chat; also counselling, support groups and benefits advice.

entries.name: brainstrust
entries.desc_en: Brain tumour charity offering personal support, coaching, patient guides and digital resources for patients and carers.

entries.name: Brain Tumour Research
entries.desc_en: Charity funding brain tumour research centres and campaigning; its website lists helplines and support services.

entries.name: Tessa Jowell Brain Cancer Mission

entries.name: Marie Curie Support Line
entries.desc_en: Support for people living with a terminal illness, their carers and the bereaved: practical and emotional help.
entries.desc_ru: Поддержка неизлечимо больных, ухаживающих за ними и переживающих утрату: практическая и эмоциональная помощь.

entries.desc_en: Advice for unpaid carers on rights, benefits, practical support and looking after yourself while caring.

entries.name: Samaritans Ireland
entries.desc_en: Free listening support, day or night, for anyone going through a difficult time or feeling suicidal.

entries.desc_ru: Мадридская ассоциация пациентов с опухолями мозга: социальная помощь, психолог, реабилитация, юридические консультации.

entries.name: AECC – Cáncer de cerebro o sistema nervioso central
entries.desc_en: Spanish patient information on brain tumours with a detailed glioblastoma section: symptoms, treatment, research.
entries.desc_ru: Информация на испанском об опухолях мозга с подробным разделом о глиобластоме: симптомы, лечение, исследования.

entries.name: SOS Voz Amiga
entries.desc_en: Anonymous emotional-support line staffed by trained volunteers; mobile numbers also listed on the site.
entries.desc_ru: Анонимная линия эмоциональной поддержки с обученными волонтёрами; на сайте также указаны мобильные номера.

entries.name: APCP – Associação Portuguesa de Cuidados Paliativos
entries.desc_en: Portuguese palliative care association: information on palliative care and services.
entries.desc_ru: Португальская ассоциация паллиативной помощи: информация о паллиативе и службах.

entries.name: Hellenic Cancer Society – Open Line
entries.desc_en: Psychological support line for cancer patients and carers (also smoking cessation counselling).
entries.desc_ru: Линия психологической поддержки для онкопациентов и ухаживающих (а также помощь в отказе от курения).

entries.name: Galilee Palliative Care Unit
entries.desc_en: Free comprehensive palliative care for people with cancer or ALS and their families, Athens area.

entries.name: Cyprus Samaritans
entries.desc_en: Free, confidential emotional support by phone and email for anyone distressed, lonely or unable to cope.
entries.desc_ru: Бесплатная конфиденциальная эмоциональная поддержка по телефону и e-mail для всех, кому тяжело.

entries.name: Cyprus Anti-Cancer Society
entries.desc_en: Free psychological support, palliative and supportive care and home care for cancer patients living in Cyprus.
entries.desc_ru: Бесплатная психологическая помощь, паллиативная и поддерживающая помощь, уход на дому для онкопациентов на Кипре.

entries.name: Richmond Foundation – 1770

entries.name: Cancerfonden – Cancerlinjen

entries.name: Svenska Hjärntumörföreningen
entries.desc_en: Swedish association for everyone affected by a brain tumour, including relatives and the bereaved; regional groups.

entries.name: Kreftforeningen – Kreftlinjen

entries.name: Pårørendealliansen
